Fuller notes (quick paste from my doc):
- Product sense: Good at structuring ambiguous problems; used "north-star" thinking to reorder roadmap items. Example used was credible but leaned on qualitative customer anecdotes rather than a measurement plan.
- Execution: Has led cross-functional launches at prior company (2 mobile features); described a stakeholder alignment ritual that sounded promising. Concern: didn't clearly explain how they measure impact post-launch. Would want a quick case study follow-up (walk me through the dashboard, the KPI you tracked, how you iterated).
- Communication: Clear, calm, and diplomatic. Would collaborate well with eng leads.

Recommendation: neutral-to-lean-hire; I want a short follow-up to probe metrics/experiments before committing.
